versions.message: Vocabulary update: re-resolved against OMOP vocabulary v5.0 29-AUG-26 (previously v5.0 27-FEB-26). 996 -> 991 concepts. Removed 5 concepts deprecated in the new release, whose replacement is already in the set: Cefazolin 1 MG/MG [Cefazolin Mip] (43693194); 2100 MG Cefazolin 1 MG/MG Injectable Solution [Cefazolin-Mip] (43706571); 2100 MG Cefazolin 1 MG/MG Injectable Solution [Cefazolin-Mip] by MIP (43814500); Cefazolin Injectable Solution [Cefazolin-Mip] (43819123); Cefazolin 1 MG/MG Injectable Solution [Cefazolin Mip] (43855229).
